text:
Vera L: Heads up — onboarding a new GPU spot-backed nodepool next week in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. We'll need extra public IPs + ENI headroom across two accounts (prod-dedicated, infra-shared). Can infra team request increases? @cloud-ops
Samir K: Numbers?
Vera L: Roughly per account per region: 500 EIPs, 300 ENIs, and bump VPC ENI limits (ENIs/sec burst) — also need IPv6 enablement on one VPC in ap-southeast-1.
Mia (infra): 500 EIPs is a big ask — AWS usually wants tight justification. Can we split across sub-accounts or rely on NAT/Reused EIPs where possible? Spot fleet usually doesn't need public IPs for internal-only workloads.
Vera L: We have a mix: some test harnesses and BYOC customer debug paths require public IPs. Can't NAT everything because of tracing and perf isolation. For MVP we need increases in infra-shared account + IPv6 enablement in ap-southeast-1.
Jordan: I can prep the quota request. Include expected traffic profile and duration. Also propose fallback: private pool with a few jump hosts in each AZ to cut EIP needs. I'll submit today.
cloud-ops-bot: Created support ticket AWS-54621 for EIP/ENI quota request (eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1). Assigned to Jordan.
Samir K: Also check VPC per-subnet IP limits — ENI-heavy instance types consume many IPs. Are we using ENI trunking or aws-cni advanced mode?
Vera L: Plan is aws-cni trunking on newer nodepools and dedicated ENIs for older GPU types. I'll attach the nodepool spec after this thread.
Mia (infra): IPv6 enablement will touch subnet configs and some internal tooling. SRE needs ~48h to validate. Jordan, please request IPv6 as a separate item and state the 48h validation window.
Jordan: Copy. Drafting justification: "GPU fleet onboarding for production inference testing, estimated 12k concurrent ephemeral pods across regions — temporary headroom request for 45 days for capacity ramp."
Vera L: :thumbsup: Please cc me on the support case. Also include cost note for EIPs (roughly $0.005/hr per EIP) so finance can estimate one-off exposure.
Samir K: Quick command to count allocated EIPs in an account: ```aws ec2 describe-addresses --query 'Addresses[*].PublicIp' --output text | wc -w```
Mia (infra): I'll run validation scripts against infra-shared and prod-dedicated accounts and flag any VPCs missing IPv6. Expect updates by tomorrow EOD.
cloud-ops-bot: Support case AWS-54621 updated: quota request submitted to AWS. Link: https://support.aws.amazon.com/cases/54621. Status: awaiting AWS response.
